pre_event_market_state: Public reporting immediately before the shock documented a very large crypto rally and heavy short-liquidation activity, establishing a leveraged and mechanically fragile background state.
Contemporaneous market discussions and reports describe large short squeezes; this supports liquidation-cascade plausibility but does not identify the first initiating trade.

public_tick_data_access.note: The required evidence is exchange-native 1s/1m spot and perpetual trade data, liquidations, open-interest changes, and order-book depth. Public search confirms such data classes exist but has not exposed the required historical second-level records for the event window.

causal_hypotheses_to_discriminate.test: One or a few large spot sells on a dominant venue moved the reference market first, followed by arbitrage and liquidations.
A derivatives market broke first and forced long liquidations propagated into spot.
Market makers simultaneously widened/cancelled bids, amplifying an otherwise ordinary sell impulse.
A contemporaneous external headline or cross-asset market move preceded crypto by seconds/minutes.
A venue, collateral, stablecoin, or infrastructure issue initiated the repricing.
The common shock was market-wide but XRP experienced extra venue/positioning/liquidity/large-holder flow that multiplied its drawdown.

required_transaction_sequence: For BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, XRPUSDT, XLMUSDT, SOLUSDT, and ATOMUSDT, acquire 1-second trades where available and 1-minute candles for 05:05-05:20 UTC.
For Binance, Bybit, OKX, Coinbase/International, Deribit where applicable, identify the first timestamp with abnormal aggressive sell volume.
Acquire perpetual-futures liquidation prints and long-liquidation notional by second/minute.
Acquire open interest immediately before, during, and after the cliff; a sharp OI drop contemporaneous with price decline supports forced deleveraging.
Acquire bid/ask depth and spread snapshots; abrupt depth withdrawal before the first trough supports liquidity-vacuum amplification.
Rank assets and venues by first-break timestamp; do not infer the initiating market from the largest percentage decline.
For XRP specifically, compare XRPUSDT spot, XRPUSDT perpetual, XRP/XLM relative value, and any large XRPL-to-exchange transfers preceding the event.
Search BTC, ETH, XRP, USDT, USDC and relevant exchange hot-wallet flows for large deposits preceding 05:11 UTC; treat on-chain inflow as a lead, not proof of execution.
Preserve null results, conflicting venue timestamps, and any evidence that XRP lagged rather than led the common shock.

decision_rules.spot_led: A spot venue must show the earliest statistically abnormal sell imbalance before derivatives liquidation acceleration on other venues.
decision_rules.derivatives_led: Perpetual/futures price or aggressive-sell flow must break first, with contemporaneous open-interest collapse and long liquidations preceding spot propagation.
decision_rules.xrp_specific_secondary: XRP-specific flow/positioning must occur after or alongside the common trigger and explain excess drawdown beyond matched controls; the size of the XRP move alone is insufficient.
decision_rules.whale_attribution: A large on-chain transfer may identify a candidate seller only if exchange deposit timing and subsequent venue execution can be linked; wallet movement alone is insufficient.

current_disposition: The synchronized BTC/ETH/ATOM/XRP cliff is preserved as a system-wide shock candidate centered near 05:11 UTC. The initiating venue/instrument and transaction remain unresolved. The strongest current next step is exchange-native tick, liquidation, open-interest, and depth reconstruction rather than blockchain-only search.
